_doc: Rules of the SubagentStart hook hooks/agent-rules.py: which digest to inject for each agent_type.
agent_type = subagent_type of the Agent call (Explore, Plan, general-purpose, claude-code-guide, feature-dev:code-reviewer, fork…).
readonly_types: research/planning agents without write access -> agent-rules/readonly.md.
skip_types: no injection (fork already inherits the whole parent context; statusline-setup is narrowly scoped).
Any other agent_type, including missing, empty or unknown -> agent-rules/mutating.md (superset, safe by default).

Digest paths are relative to the hooks/ folder. Each digest <= 200 words (checked by tests/agent-rules-tests.sh). The shipped digests are examples derived from one CLAUDE.md: replace them with your own rules.
